entities.summary: The Academy of Sciences of the Institute of Bologna is an academic society in Bologna, Italy, that was founded in 1690 (1714?) and prospered in the Age of Enlightenment. Today it is closely associated with the University of Bologna. Academy of Sciences of the Institute of Bologna is a academy of sciences in Europe, established in 1714. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
